content.title: Kulicke and Soffa (NASDAQ:KLIC) Delivers Strong Q3 Numbers, Inventory Levels Improve
content.summary: Semiconductor production equipment company Kulicke & Soffa (NASDAQ: KLIC) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 2.1% year on year to $177.6 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($190 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 13.3% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.28 per share was 26.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
